mentions.name: GitPatch
mentions.description: A git forge optimized for speed and patch-based workflows. It rewrites most server-side parts of git from scratch to avoid exec-ing the git binary or using libraries like libgit2, and uses an HTMX frontend for fast rendering.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a new type of git forge[1], optimized for speed and work with patches.

evidence.value: I'm working on a new type of git forge[1], optimized for speed and work with patches.

mentions.name: GitPatch
mentions.description: Git hosting platform for async teams that supports versioned patches and patch stacks instead of pull requests, working over the standard git SSH protocol so no git-send-email is needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: Git hosting for async teams that supports versioned patches and patch stacks instead of pull requests. All done using the standard git SSH protocol, so no git-send-email needed.
